exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Brace your core and push your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, or only as far as feels comfortable, keeping your heels down.
Press through your whole foot to stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
exercises.semantic_description: A demonstration of the bodyweight squat, moving from standing to a deep squat.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Step forward into a comfortable stride length.
Lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.
common_mistakes: Letting the front knee collapse inward.
Taking too short a step, which overloads the front knee.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Rest one hand on a wall or chair for balance.
Press up onto the balls of your feet as high as you comfortably can.
Pause for one second at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
common_mistakes: Bouncing instead of lowering with control.

exercises.name: Lying Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh muscle of the straight leg.
Lift that leg until it is level with your bent knee, keeping it straight.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch legs.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back off the mat.
Swinging the leg up with momentum.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about 60 cm (2 ft) in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees, or stay higher if that feels better.
Keep your back flat on the wall and breathe steadily.
Hold for the set time, then slide back up.
common_mistakes: Resting your hands on your thighs, which takes the load off your legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall and elbows inside your knees.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
common_mistakes: Choosing a weight so heavy that your form breaks down.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until your body makes a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes for one second at the top.
Lower your hips slowly.
common_mistakes: Lifting so high that the lower back arches.

exercises.name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked.
Lift your top knee while your feet stay touching.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
With a soft bend in your knees, push your hips back and slide the weights down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs, keeping your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
common_mistakes: Bending the knees so much that it becomes a squat.
Starting with weights that are too heavy.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
common_mistakes: Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
Only moving through a small range.
form_checklist: Keep body in a straight line
exercises.semantic_description: A demonstration of a push-up, moving from a high plank to a lowered chest.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on a sturdy counter, bench or wall, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body makes a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the surface.
Press away until your arms are straight.
common_mistakes: Using a surface that can slide or wobble.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower your elbows until your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
Press the weights up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists straight and your core gently braced.
common_mistakes: Bouncing the arms off the floor.

exercises.name: Chair Dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair placed against a wall and put your hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the seat with your knees bent.
Bend your elbows straight back to lower a few inches.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
common_mistakes: Using a chair that can slide.
Dropping too deep, which strains the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly.
common_mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them with control.
common_mistakes: Using weights that are too heavy.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it gently just above the elbow.
Draw it closer until you feel a mild stretch, never pain.
Hold, breathe slowly, then switch arms.
common_mistakes: Shrugging the shoulder toward your ear.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Rest one hand on a sturdy chair or bench with a flat back, holding a dumbbell in the other hand.
Let the weight hang straight down.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a light resistance band in front of you at shoulder height, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and gently squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull the band apart until it reaches your chest.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front and legs straight.
Gently lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral with your eyes on the floor.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
common_mistakes: Looking up and straining the neck.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale: let your belly drop and lift your chest and tailbone (cow).
Exhale: round your spine and tuck your chin (cat).
Move slowly with your breath.
common_mistakes: Forcing the end of your range of motion.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
instructions: Place your forearms on the mat with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with toes tucked.
Make a straight line from head to heels, squeezing your core and glutes.
Hold while breathing steadily. Drop to your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms reaching to the ceiling and hips and knees bent to 90 degrees.
Press your lower back gently toward the floor.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back, keeping your hips level.
Hold for a moment with your neck neutral.
Return and switch sides.
exercises.semantic_description: A demonstration of the bird dog exercise on a mat.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head and legs lifted, knees bent.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not pull on your head.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: March in Place
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent.
Lift your knees one at a time to a comfortable height.
Swing your arms naturally.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe normally.

exercises.name: Brisk Walk
instructions: Stand tall, look ahead and relax your shoulders.
Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing.
Swing your arms and let your heel land first.
Slow down gradually to cool off.

exercises.name: Easy Jog
instructions: Warm up with a brisk walk for 3 to 5 minutes.
Ease into a slow jog at a pace where you can still hold a conversation.
Take short, quiet steps landing under your body.
Finish with a few minutes of walking.

exercises.name: High Knees
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up toward hip height while pumping the opposite arm.
Alternate quickly, landing softly.
Keep your chest tall and core tight.

exercises.name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step or jump your feet back into a plank.
Step your feet back in, then stand and reach up. Jump only if it feels comfortable.

exercises.name: Step Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together.
Step one foot out to the side while raising both arms overhead.
Step back in and lower your arms.
Alternate sides at a smooth pace.

exercises.name: Sun Salutation (Surya Namaskar)
instructions: Stand at the front of your mat with palms together.
Inhale and reach your arms overhead. Exhale and fold forward with soft knees.
Step back to a plank or lower to your knees, then slide forward into a gentle cobra with elbows bent.
Press back to downward dog, step forward and rise tall.

exercises.name: Balasana (Child's Pose)
instructions: Kneel on the mat with big toes touching and knees wide apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and fold forward.
Rest your forehead gently on the mat and extend arms forward or alongside your body.
Breathe deeply into your lower back and ribs.
common_mistakes: Forcing hips down when knees are painful.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
Bend one knee and hold your ankle behind you.
Keep your knees close together and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Hold, breathe, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Loop a towel around one foot and raise that leg toward the ceiling.
Straighten the leg as far as is comfortable and feel a mild stretch behind the thigh.
Hold, breathe, then switch legs.
common_mistakes: Lifting the hips off the floor.

exercises.name: Virabhadrasana I (Warrior I)
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge with front knee bent at 90 degrees.
Turn back foot out 45 degrees, grounding firmly through heel.
Square hips forward and sweep both arms straight overhead.
Hold for 5 deep breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Adho Mukha Svanasana (Downward-Facing Dog)
instructions: From hands and knees, tuck toes and lift hips toward ceiling in an inverted V.
Press evenly through all ten fingers, rotating upper arms outward.
Pedal heels gently or keep knees slightly bent to lengthen spine.
Hold for 5 smooth breaths.
common_mistakes: Rounding lower back to force heels to the floor.

exercises.name: Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose)
instructions: Lie face down with legs extended and tops of feet flat.
Place palms flat under your shoulders with elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Inhale and gently lift your chest off the floor using your back muscles.
Keep a soft bend in elbows and open your heart forward.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release down on an exhale.
common_mistakes: Pushing too high too quickly and pinching the lower back.

exercises.name: Vrikshasana (Tree Pose)
instructions: Stand tall in mountain pose with weight evenly distributed.
Shift weight to your standing leg and place the sole of the other foot against inner calf or thigh (never on the knee).
Bring hands together at prayer position in front of your chest or reach overhead.
Fix your gaze on an unmoving spot in front of you.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathe smoothly, then switch sides.
common_mistakes: Placing the sole directly against the knee joint.

exercises.name: Paschimottanasana (Seated Forward Bend)
instructions: Sit with legs straight in front of you and toes flexed back.
Inhale arms overhead, then exhale and hinge forward from hips.
Hold shins, ankles, or feet with chest leading toward thighs.
Hold for 30 to 60 seconds with steady, deep breaths.

exercises.name: Setu Bandhasana (Bridge Pose)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on mat hip-width apart.
Press feet into the floor and lift hips toward the ceiling.
Roll shoulders underneath you and lengthen tailbone toward backs of knees.
Hold for 30 seconds, breathing smoothly, then lower vertebra by vertebra.

exercises.name: Shavasana (Corpse Pose)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs naturally apart and arms beside body, palms up.
Close your eyes and release all muscular tension from head to toes.
Allow breath to become soft, natural, and effortless.
Rest quietly for 3 to 5 minutes.
common_mistakes: Fidgeting or holding muscular tension in jaw and shoulders.

exercises.name: Tadasana (Mountain Pose)
instructions: Stand tall with big toes touching and heels slightly apart, distributing weight evenly.
Ground through the four corners of your feet and engage quadriceps lightly.
Draw your tailbone slightly down, lengthen your spine, and relax shoulders back and down.
Let arms hang naturally by your sides with palms facing forward.
Breathe steadily and hold for 30 to 60 seconds.
common_mistakes: Tensing shoulders up around the neck.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat or slightly elevated for a greater challenge.
Lean your torso back slightly to engage your core, keeping your spine straight.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest and rotate your torso smoothly from side to side.
Tap the floor beside your hip on each side before rotating back.
Continue for 10-15 controlled repetitions per side.
common_mistakes: Only moving the arms instead of rotating the entire torso.
Slumping the spine or rounding the lower back.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in a high plank position with shoulders directly above wrists and core tight.
Drive your right knee up toward your chest without letting your hips pike up.
Quickly switch legs, extending your right leg back while driving your left knee forward.
Maintain a steady, rhythmic pace while keeping your core braced and back flat.
Repeat continuously for 30 to 45 seconds.
common_mistakes: Bouncing hips up in the air.
Letting the shoulders drift backward away from the hands.

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow directly below your shoulder and legs stacked straight.
Engage your abdominal muscles and lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line.
Rest your top hand on your hip or extend it toward the ceiling.
Hold without letting your hips sag toward the mat for 20-40 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
common_mistakes: Dropping the hips toward the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until parallel to the floor.
Lead with the elbows, keeping your palms facing downward at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control over 2 seconds.
Perform 10 to 12 controlled reps without swinging.
common_mistakes: Using momentum or rocking the torso to swing the weights up.
Lifting the dumbbells above shoulder height which strains the joint.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or held at chest.
Take a controlled step backward with one leg and lower your hips.
Bend both knees to roughly 90 degrees, keeping front knee aligned over ankle.
Drive through the heel of your front foot to return to the standing position.
Alternate legs for 10-12 repetitions per leg.
common_mistakes: Leaning too far forward over the front knee.
Slamming the back knee into the floor.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand or sit upright holding a single dumbbell vertically overhead with both hands cup-gripping the top plate.
Keep your upper arms stationary close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head until your forearms pass parallel.
Contract your triceps to press the dumbbell back overhead to the start position.
Perform 10 to 12 controlled reps.
common_mistakes: Flaring elbows wide out to the sides.
Arching the lower back while pressing overhead.

exercises.name: Virabhadrasana II (Warrior II)
instructions: Step feet wide apart. Turn front foot out 90 degrees and back foot in slightly.
Inhale arms parallel to floor; exhale and bend front knee to 90 degrees.
Keep torso centered and gaze over front fingertips.
Hold for 5 deep breaths, then switch sides.
common_mistakes: Leaning torso forward over front knee.

exercises.name: Trikonasana (Triangle Pose)
instructions: Stand with wide legs. Turn front foot out 90 degrees, back foot in slightly.
Inhale arms parallel to floor, exhale and reach sideways over front leg.
Lower front hand to shin, ankle, or block, extending top arm toward sky.
Keep chest open and hold for 5 breaths.

exercises.name: Marjaryasana (Cat Pose)
instructions: Begin on all fours with wrists directly under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and round your spine upward toward the ceiling, tucking your tailbone.
Gently release your head toward the floor without forcing your chin to chest.
Draw your navel in toward your spine to deeply stretch back muscles.

exercises.name: Bitilasana (Cow Pose)
instructions: From tabletop on all fours, inhale and drop your belly toward the mat.
Lift your chest, collarbones, and tailbone toward the ceiling.
Gaze gently forward or slightly upward without compressing back of neck.
Open through the chest while keeping core lightly engaged.

exercises.name: Sukhasana (Easy Pose)
instructions: Sit cross-legged comfortably on your mat, elevating hips on a folded blanket if needed.
Lengthen your spine upward from tailbone to crown of head.
Rest your hands palms-up or palms-down on your knees.
Relax your face and shoulders, breathing deeply and evenly.
common_mistakes: Slouching or rounding the lower back.

exercises.name: Vajrasana (Thunderbolt Pose)
instructions: Kneel on the floor with knees together and big toes touching.
Lower your buttocks onto the heels, resting palms flat on thighs.
Keep the spine erect and chest open.
Breathe slowly; this pose aids digestion after meals.
common_mistakes: Allowing ankles to splay wide outward.

exercises.name: Makarasana (Crocodile Pose)
instructions: Lie prone on your stomach with legs comfortably apart, heels turned in or out.
Cross your arms in front of you, holding opposite elbows or stacking palms.
Rest your forehead or cheek on your folded forearms.
Close your eyes and breathe deeply into the belly, relaxing the entire spine.

exercises.name: Pavanamuktasana (Wind-Relieving Pose)
instructions: Lie on your back and draw both knees gently in toward your chest.
Clasp your hands or forearms around your shins.
Keep your lower back and tailbone grounded onto the mat.
Gently rock side to side to massage your lumbar spine.
common_mistakes: Lifting the head aggressively when neck is tight.

exercises.name: Baddha Konasana (Butterfly Pose)
instructions: Sit tall with soles of your feet pressed together, drawing heels comfortably near groin.
Hold feet with hands and lengthen spine upwards.
Gently press knees down toward the floor without forcing or bouncing.
Breathe into inner thighs and hips for 30 to 60 seconds.
common_mistakes: Forcefully pressing knees down with hands.
Rounding the spine into a hunch.

exercises.name: Ardha Matsyendrasana (Half Spinal Twist)
instructions: Sit with legs extended. Bend right knee and place right foot outside left thigh.
Inhale and reach left arm overhead, lengthening spine.
Exhale and twist torso right, hugging right knee with left arm or hooking elbow.
Place right fingertips on floor behind you for support. Breathe and switch sides.
common_mistakes: Slumping through the lumbar spine while twisting.

exercises.name: Virabhadrasana III (Warrior III)
instructions: From a high lunge, shift weight onto your front foot.
Hinge forward at the hips, lifting back leg parallel to floor.
Extend arms forward, sideways, or alongside body, forming a T-shape.
Keep hips level and standing knee slightly soft.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch legs.
common_mistakes: Opening the lifted hip toward the ceiling.
Arching lower back and collapsing chest.

exercises.name: Utkatasana (Chair Pose)
instructions: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Inhale and raise arms overhead, keeping shoulders relaxed.
Exhale and bend knees, sitting hips back as if into a chair.
Shift weight toward heels and keep chest lifted.
Hold for 5 breaths.

exercises.name: Natarajasana (Dancer Pose)
instructions: Shift weight onto right foot. Bend left knee and grasp inside of left foot.
Reach right arm forward and upward.
Kick left foot back into hand, opening chest and tilting slightly forward.
Maintain gaze on a fixed point. Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch.
common_mistakes: Flaring the lifted knee out wide.
Collapsing the chest forward without kicking back.

exercises.name: Garudasana (Eagle Pose)
instructions: Bend knees slightly and cross right thigh over left, hooking toes behind left calf if able.
Bring arms forward, cross left arm over right at elbows, and wrap forearms to touch palms.
Lift elbows to shoulder height and sit hips deeper.
Breathe steadily for 5 breaths, then unwind and switch sides.
common_mistakes: Tipping torso forward instead of keeping spine vertical.

exercises.name: Ardha Chandrasana (Half Moon Pose)
instructions: From Triangle Pose, bend front knee and place fingertips 6-12 inches ahead on floor or block.
Lift back leg parallel to floor while straightening standing leg.
Stack hips and shoulders vertically, extending top arm toward ceiling.
Gaze sideways or upward. Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
common_mistakes: Allowing top hip to turn down toward floor.

exercises.name: Parsvakonasana (Extended Side Angle Pose)
instructions: From Warrior II, rest front forearm on front thigh or place hand on floor/block outside foot.
Sweep top arm alongside ear, creating a straight diagonal line from back heel to fingertips.
Rotate chest open toward ceiling.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Prasarita Padottanasana (Wide-Legged Forward Bend)
instructions: Stand with feet 3-4 feet apart, toes slightly turned in.
Place hands on hips, inhale and lengthen spine.
Exhale and hinge forward from hips, lowering palms flat to floor under shoulders.
Release crown of head toward floor, keeping legs active.
Hold for 5 to 8 breaths.
common_mistakes: Rounding back instead of hinging at hips.

exercises.name: Dhanurasana (Bow Pose)
instructions: Lie on stomach, bend knees and reach back to grasp ankles.
Inhale and kick ankles back and up, lifting thighs and chest off mat.
Draw shoulder blades together and keep neck long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing smoothly, then release.

exercises.name: Ustrasana (Camel Pose)
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hips stacked directly over knees.
Place hands on lower back with fingers pointing down.
Inhale, press hips gently forward and lift chest toward ceiling.
Optionally reach hands back to touch heels while keeping hips pushed forward.
Hold for 5 breaths, then carefully rise on an inhale.

exercises.name: Janu Sirsasana (Head-to-Knee Pose)
instructions: Sit with right leg extended and left foot pressed against inner right thigh.
Inhale arms overhead, squaring chest toward right leg.
Exhale and fold forward over right thigh, holding foot or shin.
Keep spine long and breathe deeply for 5 breaths, then switch legs.
common_mistakes: Forcing forehead to knee by rounding upper back.

exercises.name: Gomukhasana (Cow Face Pose)
instructions: Stack right knee directly over left knee with feet beside opposite hips.
Reach right arm overhead, bend elbow and place hand down middle of back.
Reach left arm behind back and up, clasping fingers or holding a strap.
Keep spine tall and breathe for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
common_mistakes: Dropping chest forward to reach hands.

exercises.name: Bakasana (Crow Pose)
instructions: Squat on mat with feet together, hands shoulder-width flat on floor.
Place knees high against backs of upper arms or armpits.
Lean forward, shift weight into hands, and lift one foot then both off mat.
Engage core and round upper back slightly. Balance for 15-30 seconds.
common_mistakes: Looking down between hands instead of slightly forward.
Jumping instead of shifting weight with control.

exercises.name: Sirsasana (Headstand)
instructions: Interlace fingers and place forearms on mat elbow-width apart.
Crown of head rests on mat cupped by interlaced hands.
Lift hips, walk feet close, engage core, and float legs up vertically.
Press actively through forearms to keep neck free of compression.
Hold for 5 to 10 controlled breaths with wall support if needed.

exercises.name: Pincha Mayurasana (Forearm Stand)
instructions: Start on hands and knees, placing forearms parallel shoulder-width apart.
Lift hips into Dolphin Pose and walk feet toward elbows.
Gaze slightly forward between wrists, engage core, and kick or press legs up.
Draw ribs in and balance vertically over forearms for 5 breaths.
common_mistakes: Elbows sliding out wider than shoulders.

exercises.name: Adho Mukha Vrksasana (Handstand)
instructions: Place palms flat shoulder-width apart near a wall, spreading fingers wide.
Step one foot forward and kick back leg up into handstand.
Stack wrists, shoulders, hips, and ankles in a straight line.
Engage core and press floor actively away. Hold for 15-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Mayurasana (Peacock Pose)
instructions: Kneel with hands flat between knees, fingers pointing back toward feet.
Press elbows together into abdomen near navel.
Lean forward, extend legs straight back, and lift feet off floor parallel to mat.
Balance entirely on palms and wrists for 10-20 seconds.
common_mistakes: Elbows sliding apart away from abdomen.

exercises.name: Eka Pada Rajakapotasana (King Pigeon Pose)
instructions: From One-Legged Pigeon, bend back knee and point back foot toward ceiling.
Reach overhead with both hands to grasp back toes, flipping elbows forward.
Lift chest and curve spine in a deep backbend toward back foot.
Hold for 5 breaths, then carefully release and switch legs.
common_mistakes: Forcing foot to head without hip opening.

exercises.name: Hanumanasana (Monkey Pose / Splits)
instructions: From a low lunge, slide front foot forward while sliding back leg straight back.
Keep hips squared forward, using blocks under hands for support.
Slowly lower pelvis toward mat until both legs are straight.
Bring hands to heart or raise arms overhead. Breathe and switch sides.
common_mistakes: Opening the back hip wide to cheat depth.

exercises.name: Urdhva Dhanurasana (Wheel Pose)
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat and hands beside ears with fingers pointing toward shoulders.
Press into feet and hands simultaneously to lift body up into a full arch.
Roll shoulders open, press chest toward wall behind you, and relax neck.
Hold for 5 deep breaths, then tuck chin and lower down slowly.
common_mistakes: Flaring feet and knees wide apart.
Dumping weight into lower back instead of opening chest.

exercises.name: Eka Pada Koundinyasana (Flying Splits Pose)
instructions: From a lunge, hook front thigh over back of front upper arm.
Plant both palms firmly on floor shoulder-width apart.
Shift chest forward into Chaturanga arms, lift back leg and extend front leg straight.
Hover both legs split in air for 10-20 seconds, then switch sides.
common_mistakes: Dropping chest too low to floor.

exercises.name: Astavakrasana (Eight-Angle Pose)
instructions: Sit with legs out. Hook right leg high over right upper arm.
Plant hands on floor, cross left ankle over right ankle.
Press into hands to lift hips off floor, bend elbows to 90 degrees.
Extend both legs straight out to the right side, chest parallel to floor.
Hold for 5 breaths, then repeat on opposite side.
common_mistakes: Failing to squeeze upper arm with legs.

exercises.name: Tittibhasana (Firefly Pose)
instructions: Squat with feet slightly wider than mat. Work shoulders underneath thighs.
Plant palms flat on floor behind heels.
Shift weight back onto hands, lift feet off mat, and straighten legs out to sides.
Press firmly through hands, engage inner thighs, and lift chest for 5 breaths.

exercises.name: Vrschikasana (Scorpion Pose)
instructions: Begin in a stable Forearm Stand (Pincha Mayurasana).
Bend knees and begin arching spine, dropping feet toward crown of head.
Lift chest and head forward, gazing toward hands.
Hold for 3 to 5 controlled breaths, then return to forearm stand and lower.

exercises.name: Parsva Bakasana (Side Crow Pose)
instructions: Squat and twist torso deeply to the right, placing both hands flat on floor outside right thigh.
Rest outer right thigh across back of left upper arm.
Shift chest forward, bend elbows to 90 degrees, and float feet off floor.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then switch sides.
common_mistakes: Not twisting deep enough before placing hands.

exercises.name: Kapotasana (Pigeon Pose / Full Backbend)
instructions: Kneel upright with knees hip-width apart.
Inhale and reach arms overhead; exhale and arch backward into a deep backbend.
Lower forearms to floor and walk hands to grasp heels or ankles.
Drop head gently back, press thighs forward, and hold for 5 breaths.
common_mistakes: Pinching lower back without thoracic expansion.

exercises.name: Kukkutasana (Rooster Pose)
instructions: Sit in full Lotus Pose (Padmasana).
Slide arms down through the space between thighs and calves until palms reach floor.
Spread fingers wide and press firmly into mat.
Engage core and lift entire body and lotus legs off floor, balancing on palms.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, breathing steadily.
